study type: Prospective longitudinal, non-randomized, comparative interventional study
exposure: Expectant management for 24 hours followed by oxytocin augmentation
Immediate induction of labour with prostaglandin
outcome: Admission to the neonatal intensive care unit
Induction interval to active labour and delivery
cohort: The study included pregnant women with a gestational age of 37 weeks or more with confirmed membrane rupture, divided into two baseline-matched groups.
finding: The comparison between immediate induction with prostaglandin and expectant management followed by oxytocin augmentation revealed no definite optimum management approach, as each method has its own benefits and complications.
mod_finding: There were significant differences between the two management groups regarding mode of delivery (p = 0.040).
